SELECT order_id, product_name, category, price, quantity, total_amount, order_time, user_id, user_type, pay_type, promo_flag, region FROM orders WHERE order_id = #{orderId} LIMIT 1

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) AS totalSales, COUNT(*) AS totalOrders, COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(total_amount) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2), 0) AS avgOrderValue, COUNT(DISTINCT product_name) AS hotProductCount, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS totalUsers, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN user_type = 'new' THEN user_id END) AS newUserCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT user_id FROM orders WHERE order_time >= #{startDate} AND order_time < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND category = #{category} GROUP BY user_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ) t) AS repurchaseUsers FROM orders WHERE order_time >= #{startDate} AND order_time < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND category = #{category}

SELECT category, sales, ROUND(sales / SUM(sales) OVER (), 4) AS salesRatio, ROUND(SUM(sales) OVER (ORDER BY sales DESC, category ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) / SUM(sales) OVER (), 4) AS cumulativeRatio FROM ( SELECT category, ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2) AS sales FROM orders WHERE order_time >= #{startDate} AND order_time < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY category ) t ORDER BY sales DESC
